clock_basis: /bin/date read immediately before this exclusive write; no other timestamp in this file is a clock reading.
author: BetaFiniteControls (task subagent of Main), information-science MOLS39 slot, six-lane 96h round
authority: None. Frozen expected outcomes for a future, separately reviewed and separately GO-admitted finite control run. Grants no runtime, release, canonical-audit, job-admission, reservation or scientific authority. No case here is genuine run evidence.

harness.relation: The harness pins this plan by full SHA256 and refuses (exit 7) on any digest, format or case-set mismatch. The source disposition pins both files.

comparison_rule: For every executable case the harness builds an observed JSON object with exactly the keys of 'expected' and compares it by strict typed JSON equality: dict key sets equal, list order significant, bool never equal to int, int never equal to float, null only equal to null. Any extra or missing key, type difference or value difference is MISMATCH. The optional per-line 'info' object is never compared.

status_values.ERROR: the case procedure raised an unexpected Exception (counted as a mismatch)
status_values.INCONCLUSIVE_PRECONDITION: a declared case precondition did not hold; never MATCH
status_values.DEFERRED_NOT_EXECUTED: deferred case; prerequisites absent; nothing executed
status_values.NOT_RUN_DEADLINE: not run because the original 300 s deadline had passed
status_values.NOT_RUN_BUDGET: not run because the stdout or retained-byte budget was exhausted
status_values.BASE_EXCEPTION: a non-injected BaseException escaped a module; recorded on stdout then re-raised

exit_codes.0: every executable case MATCH and protected paths unchanged
exit_codes.3: at least one MISMATCH or ERROR, or a protected path changed during the run
exit_codes.4: no MISMATCH/ERROR but at least one INCONCLUSIVE_PRECONDITION
exit_codes.5: original deadline exceeded; run stopped early
exit_codes.6: stdout or retained-byte budget exceeded; run stopped early
exit_codes.7: refused before any case (arguments, interpreter flags, os capabilities, pins, plan, existing evidence root)
exit_codes.other: a non-injected BaseException was re-raised; the interpreter chooses the code

run_rules: No command-line arguments. Interpreter must run with -I and -B (sys.flags.isolated == 1 and sys.flags.dont_write_bytecode == 1); otherwise exit 7 before any filesystem write.

Nothing executes at import; run() does all work. stdlib only; one nonforking process; no subprocess, network, threads, signals, date helper or model call; no wall-clock timestamps are produced (the parent records /bin/date around the run).

The reader source is read by a harness-local descriptor-anchored NOFOLLOW one-link cap+1 bootstrap read, SHA256-verified, compiled with dont_inherit and executed in a fresh namespace whose __name__ is not __main__. capture4, schema2, adapter3, this plan, the MOLS39 plan v5, ext4_gate and the original DM21 are then read through a real EvidenceReader and SHA256-verified before use. Any mismatch: exit 7.

The evidence root must not exist. RUN/evidence is created with mkdirat through an anchored RUN directory descriptor only if absent and must be a real directory; the root is created by one exclusive mkdirat; FileExistsError or any symlink: exit 7.

Fixtures are created only under evidence_root/fx with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW through retained directory descriptors (mkdirat, symlinkat, linkat without following, mkfifoat). Mutations during a case are creation-only (new directory entry, new hard link) or labelled single-byte appends to the two harness-created growth fixtures of RD11. Nothing is ever unlinked, renamed, truncated, overwritten, chmod-ed or utime-d.

Protected paths are checked by lstat before the first case and after the last: MOLS39 plan audit dir, runs-ext-search-v4 and n1-fault-v1. Any change makes the exit code at least 3. The harness never opens any of them for writing.

Cases run in plan order. Each emits exactly one compact JSON stdout line; deferred cases emit DEFERRED_NOT_EXECUTED lines. A final summary line follows. stdout is capped at 1 MiB with 16 KiB reserved for the summary; retained evidence bytes are capped at 20 MiB. Breach: remaining cases NOT_RUN_BUDGET, exit 6.

One original monotonic deadline (start + 300 s) is checked inside every deadline callback given to a module and after every case; it is never renewed. Breach: remaining cases NOT_RUN_DEADLINE, exit 5.

Labelled harness exceptions (ControlDeadlineExpired, InjectedAcquisitionFault, InjectedReadFault, InjectedCloseFault, InjectedConsumerFault, InjectedBaseInterrupt) are injected only where a case says so. A non-injected BaseException escaping a module is recorded as one BASE_EXCEPTION line and re-raised (no summary).

Every descriptor or scandir handle the harness itself opens is closed exactly once. Natively acquired handles withheld from the reader by a labelled proxy are closed by the harness exactly once after an fstat identity check; no close by guessed or reused number; a proxy refuses (and records a violation for) any close of an untracked or already-closed number.
stderr stays empty on success. No fixture, negative or synthetic decision is ever written as a canonical audit or into any plan directory.

labels.SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE: Expectation, observation, context, freeze, receipt, capture and result bytes are synthesized by the harness, carry SYNTHETIC text, and are FIXTURE-mode predicate inputs only (one PLAN-mode synthetic negative, AD18, is labelled the same way). Synthetic exits are predicate inputs, never measured exits. Synthetic date records have kind SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_DATE_RECORD and are never /bin/date readings.
labels.LABELLED_FAULT_PROXY: A separate reader namespace compiled from the same verified bytes whose global os is a delegating proxy: native calls really happen unless a rule says the fault fires before the call; faults/arming are injected only at the named boundary; not kernel evidence.
labels.LABELLED_CALLBACK: A harness callable standing in for read_bytes (immutable snapshot, refusal, wrong type, counting or arming wrapper); never kernel or filesystem evidence.
labels.LABELLED_DELEGATING_READER: An object delegating every method to one real EvidenceReader, injecting only the named report() fault, clock arming or byte substitution.
labels.REAL: Unmodified real EvidenceReader namespace (real os) over real harness-created or pinned read-only files.
